Keep on Rocking: Startup Develops AI for Mapping Tunnels and Mineshafts: The Toronto-based 
startup RockMass is developing an NVIDIA AI-powered mapping platform that can help engineers 
assess tunnel stability in mines and construction. The startup’s Mapper AI device now offers a safer 
way to keep engineers farther away from a possible tunnel collapse and offers a faster system for 
gathering and processing data.
